SELECT DISTINCT e."name", e."event_space"
FROM "eventspaces" e
WHERE (LOWER(e."event_space") LIKE '%banquet hall%'
   OR LOWER(e."event_space") LIKE '%conference room%')
  AND CAST(e."capacity" AS INTEGER) >= 200
ORDER BY e."name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
3:
SELECT DISTINCT
    "r"."name" AS restaurant_name,
    "r"."food_service"
FROM
    "restaurants" "r"
WHERE
    LOWER("r"."cuisine") LIKE '%italian%'
ORDER BY
    "r"."food_service" ASC NULLS FIRST,
    "r"."name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
4:
SELECT DISTINCT
    r."name" AS restaurant_name,
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    r."food_service" LIKE '%Restaurant%'
    OR (r."food_service" LIKE '%Café%' AND r."cuisine" LIKE '%Italian%')
ORDER BY
    r."name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
6:
SELECT DISTINCT
    s."id",
    s."name",
    s."role",
    s."language"
FROM
    "staff" s
WHERE
    s."role" LIKE 'Chef'
    OR (s."role" LIKE 'Server' AND s."language" LIKE 'English')
ORDER BY
    s."role" ASC NULLS FIRST,
    s."name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
8:
SELECT DISTINCT s."name" AS chef_name, s."language"
FROM "staff" s
WHERE s."role" LIKE '%Chef%'
  AND s."language" LIKE '%English%'

UNION ALL


SELECT DISTINCT s1."name" AS server_name, s1."language"
FROM "staff" s1
JOIN "staff" s2 ON s1."language" = s2."language"
WHERE s1."role" LIKE '%Server%'
  AND s2."role" LIKE '%Chef%'
ORDER BY "language" ASC NULLS FIRST, chef_name DESC NULLS LAST;
108:
SELECT DISTINCT mr."salary"
FROM "medicalroles" mr
WHERE mr."roleid" IN (
    SELECT hmr."roleid"
    FROM "hospitals_medical_roles" hmr
    GROUP BY hmr."roleid"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT hmr."hospitalid") = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "hospitals")
);
111:
SELECT DISTINCT
    its."name" AS it_specialist_name,
    s."system_name",
    s."is_active"
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
ORDER BY
    its."name" ASC NULLS FIRST,
    s."system_name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
112:
WITH internship_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "internshipid") AS total_internships
    FROM "internships"
),
responsibility_coverage AS (
    SELECT
        r."responsibility",
        COUNT(DISTINCT ir."internshipid") AS covered_internships
    FROM "responsibilities" r
    JOIN "internships_responsibilities" ir ON r."id" = ir."responsibilityid"
    GROUP BY r."responsibility"
)
SELECT DISTINCT r."responsibility"
FROM "responsibility_coverage" r
CROSS JOIN "internship_count" ic
WHERE r."covered_internships" = ic."total_internships"
ORDER BY r."responsibility" ASC NULLS LAST;
113:
SELECT DISTINCT
    i."title" AS internship_title,
    r."responsibility" AS responsibility
FROM
    "internships" i
JOIN
    "internships_responsibilities" ir ON i."id" = ir."internshipid"
JOIN
    "responsibilities" r ON ir."responsibilityid" = r."id"
ORDER BY
    i."title" ASC NULLS FIRST;
114:
SELECT DISTINCT
    its."id" AS specialist_id,
    its."name" AS specialist_name,
    s."system_name"
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
LEFT JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
LEFT JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
ORDER BY
    its."id" ASC NULLS FIRST;
263:
SELECT DISTINCT sd."hourly_rate"
FROM "salarydetails" sd
JOIN "position" p ON sd."positionid" = p."id"
WHERE LOWER(p."title") LIKE '%software developer%'
ORDER BY sd."hourly_rate" DESC NULLS LAST;
264:
SELECT DISTINCT
    p."title" AS job_position,
    sd."salary_range" AS salary_range
FROM
    "position" p
LEFT JOIN
    "salarydetails" sd ON p."id" = sd."positionid"
ORDER BY
    p."title" ASC NULLS LAST;
265:
SELECT j."preferred_years"
FROM "jobs" j
ORDER BY j."salary" DESC
LIMIT 1;
267:
SELECT DISTINCT
    t."officelocation" AS street_address,
    s."city"
FROM
    "teachers" t
JOIN
    "students" s ON t."officelocation" LIKE '%Room%'
ORDER BY
    s."city" ASC NULLS LAST;
